top_signals.title: AI Earnings Boost Stock Futures; CPI Data Looms | Bloomberg Brief 08/12/2026
top_signals.summary:
CoreWeave and Super Micro push US stock futures higher as strong forecasts reinvigorate AI trade. Markets await key CPI data for a read on inflation.
The IEA raises concerns about global oil inventories as the US and Iran harden their stances on the Strait of Hormuz. Andrew Hollenhorst of Citi looks ahead to the CPI data and its impact on the Fed's policy discussion. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Russia Daily Oil Output Almost Million Barrels Below OPEC+ Quota
top_signals.summary: Russia’s crude-only production lagged behind its OPEC+ quota by almost a million barrels a day in July as Ukraine attacked the nation’s oil infrastructure almost daily.

top_signals.summary:

top_signals.title: Commission accelerates IRIS² deployment with enhanced security and expanded satellites network
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 07 Aug 2026 Today, the European Commission and the SpaceRISE consortium concluded negotiations and signed an implementation agreement to roll out IRIS², the European Union's new flagship satellite constellation. The agreement, among other things, adds 66 satellites into low Earth orbit to the programme, bringing the main constellation to 348 satellites, and moving it from planning to full-scale deployment.
